I believe the $1.8 billion fund will be seen as the straw that broke Trump’s legal and political back. Some thoughts...

robertreich.substack.com/p/h…

Reminder that the Trump regime is still blowing up suspected “drug boats” — killing 197 people since September. 

But no judge or jury has found these boats were trafficking drugs. We're taking Trump's word for it.

This is murder. We must not lose sight of this lawlessness.

Private equity landlords now own 1 in 8 apartments in the U.S.

Their unfettered greed is making the housing crisis worse than ever — but there's a way for renters to organize and fight back.

Video

Donald Trump owes you a tariff refund.

Video

Hourly wages are up 3% since 2019. Corporate profits are up 50%.

Labor’s piece of the economic pie is the smallest it’s been in over 75 years, while corporate profits’ share is the *biggest* it’s been since 1950.

This is what a rigged economy looks like.

Why is Trump so obsessed with taking over our museums, arts, cultural institutions — and slapping his name and face on everything?

It’s all part of his attack on the American mind. Watch.

Video

"Art of the Deal."


Tommy Vietor (@TVietor08)

The @nytimes says Trump is preparing to give Iran a $300 BILLION "investment fund" as part of whatever deal they cut to end the war???

An essay by Asli Aydintasbas from December 1, 2024 — mere weeks before Trump's second regime began — is as fresh and useful as it was then. robertreich.substack.com/p/h…

This is what courage looks like.

Video

Trump is putting his face on federal buildings, national park passes, passports, and now his regime is reportedly trying to put it on a $250 bill.

If you saw this happening in another country, what would you call it?

washingtonpost.com/investiga…

According to new reports, Trump's White House personally ordered the Pentagon to give a $620M loan to a company linked to Don Jr.

Stocks for other Don Jr.-advised defense contractors are surging, amid rumors of more DoD deals.

There's more that you should know about. Watch.

Video

The evidence continues to mount. Trump is both physically and mentally incapable of discharging the duties of president of the United States. The sooner the 25th Amendment is invoked, or he is impeached, the safer America and the world will be. robertreich.substack.com/p/h…

Being bullied for my height as a child made acutely aware of how the powerful harass and exploit the vulnerable — and set me on the path of activism.

Video

Uber’s Chief Operating Officer said it’s getting harder for the company to justify the costs of using AI.

Starbucks just scrapped its AI inventory tool for repeatedly miscounting and mislabeling items.

Is the AI bubble getting ready to burst?

Video

Cryptocurrency PAC Fairshake notched another win in last night's Texas runoff after spending nearly $6.5M to defeat Democratic Congressman Al Green.

But if you saw their ads, you'd never know who was behind them.

Video

Officials in Trump's DOJ are reportedly ready to approve Paramount’s takeover of Warner Bros after meeting with Paramount CEO David Ellison and other company executives.

This is a rotten deal that the Trump regime has rubber stamped. 

State AGs must step in and block it

Video

Where’s the uproar about waste, fraud, and abuse now?


Kyle Griffin (@kylegriffin1)

NYT Exclusive:

The contractor given a no-bid contract to repair the Reflecting Pool is being paid an inflated and excessive profit margin.

The typical margin of federal construction contracts is 6-12%. But the firm fixing the pool submitted a bid that charged 20% — adding at least $850,000 to what a more typical contract would have cost. nytimes.com/2026/05/27/us/po…

Jeff Bezos Called Me Out. Here’s My Response.

I asked earlier this week if Trump has finally overplayed his hand.

I believe the $1.8 billion fund will be seen as the straw that broke Trump’s legal and political back. Some thoughts...

https://robertreich.substack.com/p/he-has-overplayed-his-hand

Meta paid its lowest effective federal tax rate in company history last year.

Earlier this month, Meta began laying off 10% of its workforce. 

More than 8,000 people will lose jobs as it ramps up AI investment.

Zuckerberg is now worth $215 billion. 

Second Gilded Age.

Reminder that the Trump regime is still blowing up suspected “drug boats” — killing 197 people since September. 

But no judge or jury has found these boats were trafficking drugs. We're taking Trump's word for it.

This is murder. We must not lose sight of this lawlessness.
Donald Trump owes you a tariff refund.

Amazon
AMD
Axon
Boeing
Dell
Microsoft
Nvidia
Palantir

Just a few of the major corporations and government contractors Trump has bought stock in lately.

Many of his trades directly coincided with regulatory decisions his administration made that affected their profits.

Private equity landlords now own 1 in 8 apartments in the U.S.

Their unfettered greed is making the housing crisis worse than ever — but there's a way for renters to organize and fight back.
Remember that when Trump said "I am your voice," he was talking to corporate tax dodgers. www.nytimes.com/2026/05/29/b...
Donald Trump owes you a tariff refund.

Data centers’ diesel backup generators are emitting pollutants that can cause health problems for residents.

That’s on top of contributing to higher electricity prices and sucking up communities’ water.

Is it any wonder communities across the country are organizing to stop them?

Hourly wages are up 3% since 2019. Corporate profits are up 50%.

Labor’s piece of the economic pie is the smallest it’s been in over 75 years, while corporate profits’ share is the *biggest* it’s been since 1950.

This is what a rigged economy looks like.

Why is Trump so obsessed with taking over our museums, arts, cultural institutions — and slapping his name and face on everything?

It’s all part of his attack on the American mind. It's straight from the fascist playbook. Watch. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rEH7sF6pA4s

For Trump’s Justice Department to now launch a criminal investigation of E. Jean Carroll on the same claim his lawyers made years ago, which was dismissed by an appellate court, is a transparent abuse of justice, harassment of a private citizen, and violation of the rule of law.

Corporations spend more than $1.5 billion a year on union-busting.

That’s $1.5 billion they could have spent on higher wages, better benefits, and improving workplace safety.

Remember: if they weren’t so scared of worker power, they wouldn’t fight so hard against unions.

The immense economic power of the richest Americans allows them to wield immense political power, too.

They can pour millions into our elections to elect politicians that will continue to rig the system in their favor.

We must end this vicious cycle.

"Such intense concentration was not inevitable. It’s a product of decades of failure to enforce anti-merger laws that have been on the books since 1890."

www.nytimes.com/2026/05/29/o...

The U.S. is heading into "stagflation," as inflation & unemployment are rising at the same time. This is the economic nightmare Republicans built: tariff-driven inflation, a war spiking energy prices, and no end in sight. 

www.wsj.com/economy/cent...

An essay by Asli Aydintasbas from December 1, 2024 — mere weeks before Trump's second regime began — is as fresh and useful as it was then. https://robertreich.substack.com/p/how-to-survive-the-rest-of-trumps

The immense economic power of the richest Americans allows them to wield immense political power, too.

They can pour millions into our elections to elect politicians that will continue to rig the system in their favor.

We must end this vicious cycle.
Donald Trump owes you a tariff refund.
Zohran Mamdani is right. Bezos must pay his fair share in taxes.
This is what courage looks like.
Being bullied for my height as a child made acutely aware of how the powerful harass and exploit the vulnerable — and set me on the path of activism.
Trump couldn't make it to his own son's wedding, but there's another way he's still supporting him: lucrative Pentagon contracts to Don Jr.'s (and Eric's) companies.
Over 50 years later, this anti-Vietnam War PSA still rings true.
My friend Robbie went missing in action in Vietnam on October 12, 1972. His body has never been recovered. I think of him every Memorial Day — and what he died fighting for.
Jeff Bezos’s CNBC interview made headlines this week. He’s been on a PR campaign responding to his critics — myself included.
Why am I still hopeful about America, in spite of everything going on today? Because young people are waking up and taking back their future.
Forget AI. Here's what I hope the Class of 2026 actually embraces.
